name: Dhabriya Polywood Ltd
title: Dhabriya Polywood Ltd - 538715 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 revenue up 12.5% to INR264 crores with EBITDA margin 20.6%, but supply deferrals missed the 20-25% growth target, working capital ballooned on pre-buying, and a INR100 crore capex plan adds new verticals on a 66% PVC extrusion utilisation base.

utilisation.quote: our last year capacity utilization was for around 66% for PVC profile extrusion

capex.quote: The Board has approved INR100 crores strategic capital expenditure program to be deployed over financial year ' 26 to '28.

triggers.label: Payables near zero, inventory up
triggers.quote: we have paid off all our suppliers in single sort

triggers.label: Growth shortfall vs 20-25% target
triggers.quote: that growth was not up to our expectations primarily due to the supplies were deferred

triggers.label: New aluminium facade vertical INR56 crore order book
triggers.quote: we have already received, in fact, INR56 crores of orders related to this new line of business

triggers.label: Price hikes three times post West Asia
triggers.quote: we have already revised our prices three times

guidance.quote: we are targeting approximately 30% CAGR revenue growth over the long term
we are quite confident that 20% plus EBITDA margin is sustainable in longer run also
we are expecting minimum INR40 crores to INR50 crores of revenue contribution from this new division
The Board has approved INR100 crores strategic capital expenditure program

prior_guidance_check.quote: that growth was not up to our expectations primarily due to the supplies were deferred
which was subsequently increased by the board to the tune of INR100 crores

red_flags.label: Payables near zero; inventory and receivables up
red_flags.quote: our receivables have gone up, our inventory levels have gone up, and our payables are almost zero

red_flags.label: Pre-buying and supplier payment acceleration
red_flags.quote: This included faster settlement of our suppliers' dues and strategic stocking of all our extrusion - related raw materials

red_flags.label: Growth target missed; buyer-side deferrals
red_flags.quote: the supplies were deferred for couple of the projects, large projects

red_flags.label: Debt-to-equity rising toward 0.56
red_flags.quote: current level of our debt -to-equity ratio is 0.56

evasions.topic: Price vs volume split of growth
evasions.quote: the price we can't determine price growth because it depends on the market conditions
in the monetary terms I can't say you, but yes
we have not quantified this as such because it is a regular ongoing activity
